events.title: Framer founded
events.summary: Koen Bok and Jorn van Dijk founded Framer in Amsterdam in 2014 — an interactive design and prototyping tool for high-fidelity app mockups.
events.about: Framer started as a prototyping tool for designers after its founders sold Sofa to [Facebook] in 2011. It later pivoted to a full website builder in 2022 — design, [CMS], and publish from one canvas — competing with Webflow and Figma's expanding scope.

narrative.whyChosen: Framer became a leading tool bridging design and production-ready web publishing.
narrative.whyImportant: It showed designers could ship live sites without handing off to developers.
narrative.problemSolved: High-fidelity prototypes could not become production sites without a full rebuild.
